code=const axios = require('axios')

async function fesnuk(u){
    try{
        if(!/facebook\.com/.test(u)) throw new Error('Invalid url')

        return await axios.post(
            'https://likeedownloader.com/process',
            new URLSearchParams({ id:u, locale:'en' }),
            {
                headers:{
                    'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10)',
                    'Accept':'application/json,text/javascript,*/*',
                    'x-requested-with':'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    origin:'https://likeedownloader.com',
                    referer:'https://likeedownloader.com/facebook-video-downloader'
                }
            }
        ).then(function(r){

            if(!r?.data?.template) throw new Error('Fetch failed')

            function pick(re){
                const m = r.data.template.match(re)
                return m ? m[1] : null
            }

            const link = []
            for(const m of r.data.template.matchAll(/href="([^"]+)"[^>]*download/g)) link.push(m[1])

            return{
                thumb:pick(/<img[^>]+src="([^"]+)"/),
                sd:link[0]||null,
                hd:link[1]||null
            }
        })

    }catch(e){
        return{status:'error',msg:e.message}
    }
}

return await fesnuk('https://www.facebook.com/reel/1173026878305572/')
